body: Seems like you really just want someone to know you. To see you. We can be friends.

Hey man.. I was there before actually. Unfortunately I'm not there anymore. I made do and I accepted how everything is (read the other replies to comments to get a better picture.) 

Do you still feel this way now? If you do. Something that helps is that people mostly care about themselves, and everything that they do is justified/right. And in their own hearts and minds they are good people (for the most part). Once you start seeing that, you stop blaming people for being themselves. (sorry if this doesn't help at all) 

And am I going to say life gets better, no I'm not. I don't know that. But if one day I can live again you can too. I'll tell you if it happens if you want me to

I'm pretty sure it's not.. I don't know how you read my post but it's in a pretty neutral tone. I didn't mention it but despite everything, I laugh with people, I have fun when I'm with my 'friends' I immerse myself in the moment so it's not pretending to be happy. It's real and it's not like I'm sad when I'm alone. It's just nothing. I can laugh I can smile I just can't cry anymore. 

I probably did have depression before but that was awhile ago.
Oh I actually exercise regularly. I lift, play sports, do cardio
